entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, you can help me by taking back these garbage cycling shoes you sold me. This is unacceptable! I've spent thousands with VeloFit and this is the quality I get?
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase, sir. I can certainly look into this for you. Could you provide me with the order number?
I don't have the order number! Look up my account! The shoes are a disaster. They gave me horrible blisters after just one ride. I can't even wear them.

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I've found your account. I see an order for the Pro-Tread cycling shoes about 50 days ago. Is that the one?

Yes, that's it! 50 days of them sitting in a box because they're torture devices. I tried adjusting the cleats, everything. Nothing works. I want a full refund, and I want it now. Don't give me the runaround or I'm plastering this all over every cycling forum on the internet.

Sir, I assure you I'm here to help, not to give you the runaround. I can see you're a long-time VIP customer with us and we definitely value your business. Let me just place you on a brief hold to review our policy for you. It will only be a moment.
Fine. But if you come back and tell me I'm out of luck, I'm going straight to your manager. This is ridiculous.

Thank you for holding. I've reviewed your account and our policy. I'm happy to tell you that since you're within the 90-day return window, we can absolutely process a full refund for those cycling shoes. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now.
Oh. Well... okay. That's... that's what I expected. Good. So I just print the label and send them back?

That's correct. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Again, I do sincerely apologize for the trouble they caused and for your frustration. As a thank you for your loyalty and patience, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
A credit? Okay, that's... that's good. Thank you, Isaac. I appreciate that. I've just been so angry about these blisters, you know? Wasted a whole weekend of riding.
I completely understand. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. The refund and the credit are fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
